# slave / wake_the_slave

> A Pi skill that turns Ziwei Doushu charts into a print-ready, mobile-friendly Chinese PDF booklet.

## Skill

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waterman995/slave/main/SKILL.md)
- [README](https://github.com/waterman995/slave)

## Quick start for agents with shell access

```bash
git clone https://github.com/waterman995/slave.git ~/.pi/agent/skills/wake_the_slave
bash ~/.pi/agent/skills/wake_the_slave/install.sh
bash ~/.pi/agent/skills/wake_the_slave/scripts/check-env.sh
```

Then read SKILL.md and follow it. Do not invent chart facts; use the CLI in `~/ziwei-work`.

## For agents without shell access

Read SKILL.md and produce Markdown following its structure. Do not claim to generate a PDF.
